sinopsis.es: Chase Infiniti interpreta a una estudiante universitaria brillante que se enreda sentimentalmente con un profesor auxiliar mientras ambos preparan el examen Putnam, la competencia de matemáticas más dura de Norteamérica. Con Gillian Anderson y Jason Isaacs.
sinopsis.en: Chase Infiniti stars as a gifted university student who becomes romantically involved with a teaching assistant as they both prepare for the Putnam Exam, the most challenging math competition in North America. Gillian Anderson and Jason Isaacs co-star.
